item: 9. Korea: Gunsan KEPRI Doosan 3 MW on suction bucket
proposal: (missing) A real offshore demonstrator with no record: KEPCO Research Institute (KEPRI) Gunsan Port suction-bucket demonstrator, 1 x Doosan WinDS3000 3 MW (rotor 134 m per GlobalData) on a tripod suction-bucket foundation in the sea at Gunsan Port, installed October 2016. No citable coordinates and no source on current operation.
note_zh: 電力專刊《일렉트릭파워》（2021-08-09，KEPRI 副院長訪談）：電力研究院 2016 年 10 月在群山港成功以吸力式桶型基礎設置 3 MW 級離岸風機 1 部；基礎由 에드벡트 設計製造，「群山外海的 3 MW 離岸風機」。GlobalData（power-technology）：Gunsan Port – KEPRI Suction Bucket Demonstrator，3 MW 離岸，2016 年商轉，斗山 1 部 WinD3000/134。所以是在海上（港內水域），不是陸上；荷蘭 RVO 說裝在陸上不對。資料裡沒有任何紀錄涵蓋它（群山附近只有 GEM 的 Gogunsan 陸域規劃案）。OSM 在 35.972 N、126.515 E 與 35.969 N、126.515 E 有兩個業者為「한국전력공사 전력연구원」、附航標燈的風機節點，但標 1.5 MW、2017-07 起，與「1 部 3 MW、2016-10」不符，未採用為座標。現況（是否仍運轉）查不到。
note_en: Electric Power Journal (9 Aug 2021, interview with KEPRI's deputy head): KEPRI installed one 3 MW-class offshore turbine on its suction-bucket foundation at Gunsan Port in October 2016; the foundation was designed and built by Advect, the firm that built “the 3 MW offshore turbine off Gunsan”. GlobalData (power-technology): Gunsan Port – KEPRI Suction Bucket Demonstrator, 3 MW offshore, commissioned 2016, one Doosan WinD3000/134. So it stands in the sea (port waters), not on land as RVO put it. No record covers it (the only nearby record is GEM's onshore pipeline Gogunsan). OSM has two KEPRI-operated turbine nodes with navigation lights at 35.972 N 126.515 E and 35.969 N 126.515 E, but tagged 1.5 MW each from July 2017, which does not match one 3 MW unit from October 2016, so they are not used for a position. Current operating status unknown.
why: No citable coordinates (OSM nodes unnamed and inconsistent) and no source on whether it still runs; cyber.kepco.co.kr newsletter fails TLS (SSLV3 handshake) and mdpi.com returns 403.
